reviews.title: Good purchase
reviews.comment: At first I was kinda sketched out since it was a remanufactured unit, notice when opening the box that one of the capacitors was slightly bent over, i made sure to slowly push it back stright by hand and everything works as intended, the box wasnt the correct/original box it was just an all black MSI Branded box but had all the stand off and screws and antennas that the factory new one would have. Had it for about a month now and seems to be running great
reviews.author: Austin S.

reviews.title: Would buy again from seller
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1tZApkWTSL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71ymjY8NR2L._SY256.jpg The board looks goos has a bit of scratches i thibk from shipping tho. But other wise almost looks bran new. I gave 4 stars only because the board seems to have issues flashing bios with thr bios flash in the mother board this could also be a msi issue the bio says 8-15  on the msi page but 8-4 in bios. The second time I updated it I used flash in bios and usb on the front and the system finally worked.  So far correct parts came in original box and wifi parts  board look like some one put it in maybe could not get the bio updated and returned it. Msi does honor the RMA I can register it with them and it has 1 year still on the warranty so all in all good board. After 4 hours trouble shooting I think we got it working. Im going to test it more in the next 15 days and see if any think else happen but I do thi k the board is good just electronics sometime have glitches. I
